sourceNotes.referenceTitle: Rose Gold Crystal Rope Bar Ring
sourceNotes.rawContent:
A classy gold-toned ring with a braided rope-style band and a crystal-studded rectangular bar. The sleek and elegant design makes it an ideal piece for stacking or wearing as a statement ring and complements both ethnic and western outfits.
- Material: Alloy metal
- Plating: Gold finish
- Stone Type: Pave-set cubic zirconia
- Design: Rope-style band with crystal bar
- Size / Fit: Adjustable
- Best Suitable For: Daily wear, office wear, casual styling
